public.title: Subsets
public.description: Return every subset of the distinct input integers. Within each subset sort ascending. Sort the result lexicographically by numeric elements, putting a shorter prefix before a longer one. There are 0 to 10 distinct integers between -100 and 100. Include the empty subset.
hints: Sort first and emit each path before extending it.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Preorder enumeration over sorted choices directly produces numeric lexicographic order. There are 2 to the n subsets and O(n times 2 to the n) output size.
